Article 48 — Notification thresholds (Decree Law No. 211)

Concentration operations must be notified to the National Economic Prosecutor's Office when:

a) the sum of the sales in Chile of the economic agents that plan to concentrate, during the fiscal year prior to that in which the notification is verified, exceeds UF 2,500,000; and the sales in Chile, separately, of at least two of the economic agents that plan to concentrate, during the fiscal year prior to that in which the notification is verified, exceeds UF 450,000 each.

The thresholds are expressed in Unidades de Fomento (UF) and are updated by the FNE pursuant to Exempt Resolution No. 157 of 2019.
